video.title: October Morning Prayer 🙏 | Start This New Month With God | Prayer for Peace, Protection & Blessings
video.description:
Welcome to October. 🙏❤️

Before you begin this new month, take a quiet moment to pray, breathe, and place October completely in God’s hands.

This October morning prayer is a peaceful new month prayer for anyone seeking God’s presence, protection, guidance, peace, favour, strength, and blessings throughout the month.

Heavenly Father, go before us in October. Watch over us, guide our decisions, protect our families, strengthen our hearts, and give us peace in every situation we face.
Whatever this new month brings, remember that you do not have to walk through it alone. God is already ahead of you.

If this prayer speaks to your heart, stay until the end, pray along, and type AMEN in the comments.

Subscribe to this channel for peaceful morning prayers, daily prayers, Christian prayers, prayers for protection, prayers for blessings, prayers for breakthrough, and quiet moments with God.

❤️ Happy New Month. May October bring you closer to God, fill your heart with peace, and give you beautiful reasons to say, “God has been faithful 
#OctoberMorningPrayer #NewMonthPrayer #OctoberPrayer #MorningPrayer #MorningGracePrayers #DailyPrayer #ChristianPrayer #PrayerForProtection #PrayerForBlessings #PrayerForPeace #PrayerForFavour #PrayerForBreakthrough

transcript.text: Heavenly Father as this new morning begins
and as we step into the beautiful month of October
we come quietly into your presence
thank you for the gift of another day
thank you for the breath in our lungs the strength to rise
and the Grace that has carried us this far
we do not take this new month for granted Heavenly Father
thank you for bringing us into October
a month we have never seen before
a month filled with moments we cannot yet predict
but a month that is already known by you before we make our plans
before we worry about what lies ahead
we choose to place this month in your hands
Lord we surrender October to you
we surrender our plans our expectations our unanswered questions
our dreams our families our work our relationships our finances
and every concern that has been quietly sitting in our hearts
take control Lord where we do not know the way lead us
where we feel uncertain give us peace where we feel tired
give us strength where we are afraid
remind us that you are near heavenly father
you are the god who never sleeps and never grows weary while we rest
you watch over us while we sleep you remain awake
while we are unaware of what is happening around us
your eyes remain upon your children
thank you for being our constant protector
thank you for the dangers you kept us from
even the ones we never knew existed
thank you for the battles you fought for us quietly
thank you for doors you closed because you saw what we could not see
this morning we choose to trust you
we may not know what October will bring but we know who holds October
and because you hold this month
we do not have to carry the weight of tomorrow Today
father teach our hearts to rest in you
help us not to be consumed by things we cannot control
help us to stop replaying yesterday and worrying about tomorrow
give us Grace to receive today as a gift
let your peace settle over our hearts this morning
for anyone waking up with a heavy heart Lord bring comfort
for anyone who feels overwhelmed bring stillness
for anyone waiting for an answer give patience
for anyone who feels forgotten remind them that you see them
and father as we enter this new month let your presence go before us
let your wisdom guide every decision we make
let your hand rest upon our homes our families and everyone we love
let your Protection surround us wherever we go
and when October does not unfold exactly as we planned
help us remember that your plans are still good
help us trust you even when we cannot understand you
help us remain peaceful when things are uncertain
help us remain grateful when the answer has not yet come
and when we become tired
remind us that we can come back to you and simply rest
because in your presence
we do not have to pretend that we have everything figured out
we can breathe we can be still we can release the weight
and we can trust that you are God
Heavenly Father as this new month begins
there are things we are carrying that no one else knows about
there are prayers we have whispered in the quiet
there are desires we have not spoken aloud
there are situations we have been trying to understand
and there are places in our hearts that need your healing
Lord we bring them all before you now
we bring those hidden places before you
the things we have been too afraid to say
the questions we have been carrying

transcript.text: give us the discernment to recognize that it came from you.
Heavenly Father, let this month be different,
not because everything around us will suddenly become perfect,
but because we will walk through it with you.
When the days are beautiful, let us remember you.
When the days are difficult, let us run to you.
When blessings come, keep our hearts humble.
When challenges come, keep our hearts steady.
And when we do not understand what you are doing, help us trust your character.
Lord, protect our minds this month.
Protect us from anxiety that steals today's peace by making us afraid of tomorrow.
Protect us from comparison that makes us forget how far you have brought us.
Protect us from discouragement when our journey does not look like someone else's.
Protect us from making decisions out of fear.
Instead, fill our hearts with your peace, give us quiet confidence,
not confidence in ourselves alone, but confidence in you.
Father, watch over our going out and our coming in.
Watch over our families, watch over the people we love, even those who are far away from us.
Go ahead of us into every place we will enter this month.
Be present in our homes, be present at our workplaces, be present in our conversations.
Be present in our decisions, be present even in the moments when we feel alone.
And Heavenly Father, if there is anything we are about to walk into this month that could harm us, expose it before it reaches us.
If there are relationships that are not good for us, give us wisdom.
If there are opportunities that are not from you, give us discernment.
If there are paths that would take us away from your purpose, gently redirect our steps.
And if there are blessings you have prepared for us, give us the courage to receive them without fear.
Lord, we trust you with October.
We trust you with what we know, we trust you with what we do not know.
We trust you with the answered prayers and the unanswered ones.
We trust you with the beginning, the middle, and the end.
And this morning, we choose to rest,
not because everything is settled, but because we know that you are with us.
So let your presence become our place of rest,
let your voice become our reassurance,
let your promises become our anchor,
and let your peace remain with us throughout this entire day,
even when the world around us becomes noisy,
even when plans change, even when unexpected things happen.
Help us remember to come back to you, to breathe, to pray, to trust, and to rest,
because you are still watching over us, you are still faithful, you are still God,
and you are already in every moment of this new month that we have not yet reached.
Heavenly Father, as we step further into this new month,
help us remember that we do not have to know everything that lies ahead.
You already know, you know the opportunities that will come our way,
you know the conversations we will have, you know the doors that will open and the ones that will close,
you know the people we will meet and the moments that will shape us.
Nothing in October will surprise you.
So, Father, we place our unknown future into your very capable hands.
Give us grace for each day as it comes,
help us not to borrow tomorrow's worries.
Give us today's strength for today's responsibilities.
When tomorrow arrives, you will give us tomorrow's grace.
Heavenly Father, I pray for the person listening right now
who has entered this new month with a prayer in their heart.
Maybe they are waiting for a financial breakthrough, maybe they are waiting for a job,
maybe they are believing for healing, maybe they are praying for their marriage, their family, their children, or a relationship.
Maybe they simply want peace after a season that has been emotionally exhausting.
Father, meet them exactly where they are.
You know what they need before they even ask.
Provide where there is lack, make a way where there seems to be no way,
give clarity where there is confusion, give strength where there is weakness,
give hope where disappointment has settled in.
And where the answer requires waiting, give them the grace not to lose heart.
Lord, remind us that waiting does not mean you have forgotten us.
Silence does not mean absence, a closed door does not mean the end of our story.
Sometimes you are working in places we cannot see, sometimes you are preparing us while we are asking you to change the situation.
And sometimes, Father, you are protecting us from something we desperately wanted.
Give us the wisdom to trust you in all of it.
Heavenly Father, let October be a month where our hearts become quieter before you.

transcript.text: all along.
So today we release October into your hands.
We release the worries, we release the expectations,
we release the fear, we release the need to understand everything,
and we receive your peace, we receive your grace,
we receive your strength,
we receive the assurance that we are not alone.
Heavenly Father, thank you for bringing us into another month,
thank you for every unseen protection,
thank you for every answered prayer,
thank you for every prayer you are still preparing to answer,
thank you for the doors you will open
and the doors you will lovingly keep closed,
thank you because our future is safe in your hands.
As we go into this day, let us carry your peace with us,
may our words be kind, may our hearts be gentle,
may our choices honor you,
may our lives reflect your love,
and when we become overwhelmed,
bring us back to this simple truth,
you are God, you are with us,
you are for us, and we can rest in you.
In Jesus' name, Amen.
If you prayed this prayer from your heart,
take one more quiet moment before you begin your day.
Breathe, be still,
and remember God has already gone before you into October.
You do not have to figure everything out today,
walk with him one day at a time.
If this prayer blessed you, don't keep it to yourself.
Take a moment to like this video, subscribe to this channel,
and turn on the notification bell so you can begin each day
with a quiet moment in God's presence.
And before you leave, tell me in the comments,
what are you trusting God to do for you this October?
Write your prayer below.
Your words may be the encouragement someone else needs today.
Send this prayer to a friend, family member, or loved one
who needs to be reminded that God is with them in this new month.
May October be a month of peace, protection, direction,
favor, and beautiful testimonies.
See you in the next prayer.
Until then, rest in God's presence.
